locator: https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/reports/retention#Retention > ### Retention Curve > **Incomplete Buckets:**; ### User Cohort Buckets; **2. How is Retention calculated?** (FAQ)
extract: Asterisked buckets are described as still in flux while time is ongoing. The FAQ says intervalized retention averages only completed time periods so users have an equal opportunity to qualify; cohort buckets count unique users meeting the A-event criteria in the interval.
relevance: Shows maturity/completeness and cohort rules matter in the vendor report.
limitations: Does not establish this case's maturity rule, cohort eligibility, denominator, or treatment of missing/duplicate events.

locator: https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/reports/retention#Retention > **3. How is the "Average" row for Retention reports calculated?** (FAQ); **4. What does the Metric view for Retention Trends show?** (FAQ)
extract: The FAQ describes weighted average calculations across completed buckets and distinguishes the overall value shown by a trends Metric view from a cohortized weighted-average bucket.
relevance: An aggregate display can depend on aggregation/view settings; a bare label is insufficient to identify the calculation.
